newsitem.title: USA: Boca Research says patent suit is meritless.
newsitem.headline: Boca Research says patent suit is meritless.

text.p: Boca Research Inc said Friday it believes the patent infringement suit filed against it by privately-held General Patent Corp International is without merit.
General Patent charged in a suit, announced July 8, that Boca and six other companies infringed on four patents that cover specific aspects of PC Card modems.
Boca said that its lawyers have conducted a preliminary review and are confident that its PC Card modem technology does not infringe on GPC's patents and believes it will be vindicated in court.
Boca designs, manufactures, markets and supports data communications, videoconferencing, multimedia and networking products.
